name: search_rackets
description: Look up rackets in the Baseline Tennis catalog. Two modes: (1) the shopper names a specific racket: send only product_name; (2) the shopper wants a recommendation: send max_price and skill_level, plus playing_style if known. Every result includes product_id; pass that exact value to check_inventory and book_appointment. In lookup mode check match_status: found = one racket; ambiguous = ask the shopper which of the results they mean; not_found = we don't carry it, so don't describe it. Returns product details only; it does NOT say whether anything is in stock.

product_name.description: Lookup mode: the racket name as the shopper said it, e.g. SpinCraft 98. Omit when asking for a recommendation.

max_price.description: Recommendation mode: the shopper's maximum budget in US dollars, e.g. 150. Required together with skill_level unless product_name is given.

skill_level.description: Recommendation mode: the shopper's tennis experience level. Required together with max_price unless product_name is given.

playing_style.description: Recommendation mode, optional: preferred playing style. Omit if the shopper has no preference.
